title: Syrian-Style Tagine with Yellowed Rice and Pilchards
description: A flavorful and aromatic North African-inspired dish made with yellowed rice, pilchards, and a hint of Syrian spices. This tagine is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and sauté until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, and chili flakes. Cook for 1 minute.
Add the pilchards and cook until heated through.
Add the yellowed rice to the saucepan and stir to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes or until the rice is lightly toasted.
Add 2 cups of water to the saucepan and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20-25 minutes or until the water is absorbed.
Fluff the rice with a fork and serve hot.
